context_for_next_testing_agent: All V4 features are working correctly. The placement_constraints table does NOT exist in Supabase yet - the code handles this gracefully with try/catch (shows 'Contraintes (0)' and logs warning to console). Constraint creation will fail with a toast error but does NOT crash the app. The 3 errors badge in bottom left corner are pre-existing React 19/Radix-UI ref warnings - ignore them. To access seating plan editor: login as vie scolaire, go to Plans de classe, expand 6A, expand Jean Durand, click the pencil edit icon on a plan row.
